name: Elaine Alaniz
office: Los Angeles Community College District, Member of the Board of Trustees, Seat 4

items.text: Elaine Alaniz is a healthcare workforce specialist who says she is a U.S. Small Business Administration public affairs specialist. She wants instruction to keep pace with workforce changes. She supports credentials and apprenticeships in healthcare, trades, tech, and public safety. She favors low- or no-cost digital materials and scrutinizing spending. She says the board should focus on policy, budgets, and oversight, not directing faculty.
